exposure: combined bilateral superficial cervical plexus block and general anesthesia
cohort: One pregnant patient diagnosed with primary hyperparathyroidism and a 19-week intrauterine pregnancy.
finding: Surgical removal of the parathyroid lesion after lowering blood calcium concentration in mid-pregnancy, under combined cervical plexus block and general anesthesia, led to no maternal or fetal complications and a healthy birth.
followup_time: Up to 18 weeks post-surgery (until birth at 37 weeks gestation)
